title: Leap year, precisely specified
prompt: Implement `boolean isLeapYear(int year)`. The full rule: divisible by 4 → leap, EXCEPT centuries — divisible by 100 is NOT leap unless also divisible by 400. So 2000 was leap, 1900 was not, 2024 is.

tests.name: ordinary non-leap years
tests.code:
CjTestBase.checkTrue(!Solution.isLeapYear(2023), "2023 is not leap");
CjTestBase.checkTrue(!Solution.isLeapYear(1900), "1900 is not leap (century rule)");

tests.name: the 400-year exception
tests.hint: Divisible by 400 wins over the 100 rule.
